renderedPublicTreeEquivalence.note: The screenshot-driven UI-polish revision passed isolated build, public-surface, Glaze target, and browser validation before this non-public acceptance record was reconciled.

visualReview.notes: Human screenshots of the prior candidate identified oversized hero typography, excessive section spacing, tiny secondary text, sticky-navigation overlap in the Firefox capture, and broken word wrapping on GitHub. Revision a2aeea566e4831a59348b966d5c15631c77a80cb applies the responsive UI-polish correction. A fresh human visual review of this corrected rendered preview is still required before acceptance.

keyboardReview.notes: Human keyboard-only navigation and focus review is required before production acceptance.

assistiveTechnologyReview.notes: Appropriate human assistive-technology review is required before production acceptance.

performance.note: Hosted CI and local browser smoke are regression evidence only; representative performance acceptance remains separate where required by the current GoreeCloud website and Glaze UI requirements.

rollback.note: The feature branch and pull request do not replace production until merge and Cloudflare publication. Prior main history remains available for controlled rollback.

productionApproval.note: Production approval is blocked until all required human review and remaining consumer-acceptance evidence is complete.
